service: Data Central (AAO/Macquarie) IVOA TAP v1.0, anonymous access
access_credentials: none - public anonymous POST, no login, no API key, no terms accepted
count_check_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM sami_dr3.MGEPhotomUnregDR3

columns.name: CATID
columns.description: SAMI Galaxy ID. Galaxies with two entries have both VST and SDSS photometry.

columns.name: ReMGE
columns.description: Circularised effective radius from MGE fit.

columns.name: mMGE
columns.description: Total AB magnitude from the MGE fit. No corrections applied.

columns.name: PAMGE
columns.description: Position Angle of the MGE model, from N to E is positive.

columns.name: epsMGE_Re
columns.description: Model isophotal ellipticity at  one Re.

columns.name: dist2NNeigh
columns.description: Distance to nearest neighbour from SExtractor source extraction.

reference: Croom et al. 2021, MNRAS 505, 991 - the SAMI Galaxy Survey Data Release 3
extraction: SELECT * over the TAP table, VOTable saved byte-for-byte; TSV is a direct astropy Table -> pandas dump with no unit conversion, no cut, no join.
